parts.target: A **WORLD EATERS POSSESSED** unit of yours that is yet to be picked to move or to declare a charge in this phase.
parts.effect: Whenever a model of the unit makes a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** or **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** during the rest of the phase, it can pass over enemy models other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**. It can enter [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of those models during the move, but only a Charge move can finish there, and it passes any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically.

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) or [your Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase).

**Target:** A **WORLD EATERS POSSESSED** unit of yours that is yet to be picked to move or to declare a charge in this phase.

**Effect:** Whenever a model of the unit makes a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** or **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** during the rest of the phase, it can pass over enemy models other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**. It can enter [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of those models during the move, but only a Charge move can finish there, and it passes any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically.
